scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The club’s fictional leaf helper succeeds on a pale table but struggles when the same leaf is placed on dark card. Tara asks whether the helper learned useful leaf features or merely followed a background that happened to appear in its training pictures.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: Background can be a shortcut that fails in a new setting. The class compares shape and edge information with table colour, then marks object cells in an explicitly described practice grid. The story illustration sets the scene; the numbered cell description supplies the exact task evidence.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The teacher moves the object to a different column while keeping its identity unchanged. Neel must update the selected mask rather than repeat old cell positions. Testing changed backgrounds and positions helps investigate the shortcut, but a few successful pictures still do not establish performance in every environment.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The same leaf was recognised on pale card but not dark card. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Retest the same object with varied backgrounds and record the differences. This investigates a possible shortcut without changing the label to hide the error.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate object and background, then mask the object, then retest a changed position. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
